notes: PleaToken mints 1,000,000,000 PLEA with 18 decimals once to msg.sender in its argument-free constructor. Transfers have no fees. Holders may burn their own tokens, reducing totalSupply; there is no subsequent minting, owner, or privileged role. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
